{
  "name": "magpie-sim",
  "version": "0.6.0",
  "description": "Sim a crossword position in MAGPIE and browse the results in a pane, with a board picture of each play: /magpie <rack | CGP | .cgp/.gcg path or URL>. Installs MAGPIE itself on first use.",
  "author": {
    "name": "olaugh"
  },
  "types": "./types/index.d.ts",
  "userConfig": {
    "language": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Language",
      "description": "The language you play in.",
      "default": "English",
      "options": [
        "English",
        "Français",
        "Deutsch",
        "Nederlands",
        "Català",
        "Polski"
      ]
    },
    "lexicon": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Lexicon",
      "description": "The lexicon a position is simmed in when it names none.",
      "default": "CSW24",
      "options": [
        "CSW24",
        "NWL23",
        "CSW21",
        "NWL20",
        "TWL14",
        "CSW15",
        "TWL06",
        "CSW12",
        "CSW07",
        "TWL98",
        "OSWI",
        "OSW4",
        "OSW3",
        "OSW2",
        "OSW1",
        "FRA20",
        "RD29",
        "DSW25",
        "DISC2",
        "OSPS49"
      ]
    },
    "magpieDir": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "MAGPIE directory",
      "description": "Where MAGPIE is installed: a directory holding bin/magpie and data/. Empty is the one the mod installs it in: ~/.magpie, or %LOCALAPPDATA%\\MAGPIE on Windows.",
      "default": ""
    }
  }
}
